  <script>
  (function () {
    if (window.__avataarTracking) return;
    window.__avataarTracking = true;
  
    /* ===================== CONFIG ===================== */
    var VARYA_HOST = 'varya.avataar.ai';
    var PAGE_NAMES = {
      '/': 'Home',
      '/platform-and-technology': 'Platform & Technology',
      '/use-cases': 'Use Cases',
      '/about': 'About',
      '/contact': 'Contact'
    };
    var NAV_ITEMS = [
      'QUESTIONS', 'TRY IT LIVE', 'PLATFORM', 'HOW WE WORK', 'PROOF', 'WHY AVATAAR',
      'HOME', 'PLATFORM & TECHNOLOGY', 'USE CASES', 'ABOUT', 'CONTACT'
    ];
    var CTA_ITEMS = [
      'SCOPE A WORKFLOW', 'TRY IT LIVE', 'PUT IT ON THE SCOPING AGENDA', 'BRING ONE WORKFLOW',
      'RUN ONE YOURSELF', 'SCOPE YOURS', 'ASK WHAT THE NUMBER WOULD BE',
      'EVERY SCOPING SESSION INCLUDES A CONTROL-PLANE WALKTHROUGH',
      'DISCOVER', 'LEARN MORE', 'BOOK MEETING'
    ];
    var INDUSTRIES = ['Financial services', 'Healthcare', 'Real estate', 'Retail & consumer goods'];
    var SOCIAL = {
      'linkedin.com': 'LinkedIn', 'x.com': 'X', 'twitter.com': 'X',
      'instagram.com': 'Instagram', 'facebook.com': 'Facebook'
    };
    var UTM_KEYS = ['utm_source', 'utm_medium', 'utm_campaign', 'utm_content', 'utm_term'];
    var UTM_STORE = 'avataar-utm';
  
    /* ===================== HELPERS ===================== */
    function cleanPath(p) { return (p || '/').replace(/\/+$/, '') || '/'; }
    function pageNameFor(p) { p = cleanPath(p); return PAGE_NAMES[p] || p; }
  
    function track(name, props, beacon) {
      try {
        if (!window.mixpanel) return;
        props = props || {};
        if (!props.page) props.page = cleanPath(location.pathname);
        if (!props.page_name) props.page_name = pageNameFor(props.page);
        if (beacon) mixpanel.track(name, props, { transport: 'sendBeacon' });
        else mixpanel.track(name, props);
      } catch (e) {}
    }
  
    function linkText(el) {
      return String(el.innerText || el.textContent || el.getAttribute('aria-label') || el.title || '')
        .replace(/\s+/g, ' ').trim().slice(0, 120);
    }
    function norm(text) {
      return text.toUpperCase().replace(/[→↗➔➜›»]/g, '').replace(/\s+/g, ' ').trim();
    }
    function matchCta(TEXT) {
      for (var i = 0; i < CTA_ITEMS.length; i++) {
        if (TEXT === CTA_ITEMS[i] || TEXT.indexOf(CTA_ITEMS[i]) === 0) return true;
      }
      return false;
    }
  
    function sectionOf(el) {
      var n = el;
      while (n && n.nodeType === 1) {
        if (n.id && /^(SECTION|HEADER|FOOTER|NAV|MAIN|DIV)$/.test(n.tagName) && n.id !== 'avx-field') return n.id;
        n = n.parentElement;
      }
      var w = el.closest('header, nav, footer');
      return w ? w.tagName.toLowerCase() : '';
    }
  
    function inNav(el) {
      return !!el.closest('header, nav, [class*=\"nav\"], [id*=\"nav\"], [class*=\"header\"], [id*=\"header\"]');
    }
  
    function ancestorHasText(el, needle, maxDepth) {
      var n = el, d = 0;
      while (n && n.nodeType === 1 && d <= maxDepth) {
        var txt = String(n.innerText || n.textContent || '').toUpperCase();
        if (txt.length < 800 && txt.indexOf(needle) !== -1) return true;
        n = n.parentElement; d++;
      }
      return false;
    }
  
    // Finds which industry card an element belongs to
    function industryOf(el) {
      var n = el, d = 0;
      while (n && n.nodeType === 1 && d < 10) {
        var txt = String(n.innerText || n.textContent || '').toUpperCase();
        var found = [];
        for (var i = 0; i < INDUSTRIES.length; i++) {
          if (txt.indexOf(INDUSTRIES[i].toUpperCase()) !== -1) found.push(INDUSTRIES[i]);
        }
        if (found.length === 1) return found[0];
        if (found.length > 1) return '';
        n = n.parentElement; d++;
      }
      return '';
    }
  
    // Keep the landing UTMs for the whole visit
    (function saveUtm() {
      try {
        var here = new URLSearchParams(location.search), found = {}, any = false;
        UTM_KEYS.forEach(function (k) { if (here.get(k)) { found[k] = here.get(k); any = true; } });
        if (any) sessionStorage.setItem(UTM_STORE, JSON.stringify(found));
      } catch (e) {}
    })();
    function getUtm() {
      try { return JSON.parse(sessionStorage.getItem(UTM_STORE)) || {}; } catch (e) { return {}; }
    }
  
    function varyaUrl(href, medium) {
      var u = new URL(href, location.href);
      var utm = getUtm();
      u.searchParams.set('utm_source', 'avataar.ai');
      u.searchParams.set('utm_medium', medium);
      u.searchParams.set('utm_campaign', 'avataar_site');
      UTM_KEYS.forEach(function (k) { if (utm[k]) u.searchParams.set('ref_' + k, utm[k]); });
      u.searchParams.set('ref_page', cleanPath(location.pathname));
      try { var id = mixpanel.get_distinct_id(); if (id) u.searchParams.set('mp_ref_id', id); } catch (e) {}
      return u.toString();
    }
  
    /* ===================== SCOPING FORM ===================== */
    var lastFormTrack = 0;
    var formStarted = false;
  
    function formContainer(el) {
      var f = el.closest('form');
      if (f) return f;
      var n = el.parentElement, d = 0;
      while (n && d < 8) {
        if (n.querySelectorAll('input, textarea, select').length >= 3) return n;
        n = n.parentElement; d++;
      }
      return null;
    }
  
    function fieldLabel(f) {
      return String(f.name || f.id || f.getAttribute('aria-label') || f.placeholder || '').toLowerCase();
    }
  
    function submitAttempt(el) {
      if (Date.now() - lastFormTrack < 3000) return;
      lastFormTrack = Date.now();
  
      var c = formContainer(el);
      var role = '', when = '', missing = [], valid = true;
  
      if (c) {
        var selects = c.querySelectorAll('select');
        for (var s = 0; s < selects.length; s++) {
          var sel = selects[s];
          var val = sel.options[sel.selectedIndex] ? sel.options[sel.selectedIndex].text : sel.value;
          var lbl = fieldLabel(sel);
          if (/role/.test(lbl) || (!role && s === 0 && !/when|time/.test(lbl))) role = val;
          else when = val;
        }
        var inputs = c.querySelectorAll('input, textarea');
        for (var i = 0; i < inputs.length; i++) {
          var f = inputs[i];
          if (f.type === 'hidden' || f.type === 'submit' || f.type === 'button') continue;
          var label = fieldLabel(f) || ('field_' + (i + 1));
          var empty = !String(f.value || '').trim();
          var invalid = f.checkValidity && !f.checkValidity();
          if (invalid || (empty && (f.required || /name|email|company/.test(label)))) {
            valid = false;
            missing.push(label);
          }
        }
      }
  
      if (valid) track('Contact Form Submitted', { role: role, when: when, section: sectionOf(el) }, true);
      else track('Form Error', { missing_fields: missing.join(', '), section: sectionOf(el) });
    }
  
    function onSubmit(e) { submitAttempt(e.target); }
  
    function onInput(e) {
      var t = e.target;
      if (formStarted || !t || !/^(INPUT|TEXTAREA|SELECT)$/.test(t.tagName)) return;
      formStarted = true;
      track('Form Started', { section: sectionOf(t) });
    }
  
    /* ===================== CLICKS ===================== */
    function onClick(e) {
      var t = e.target;
      if (t && t.nodeType !== 1) t = t.parentElement;
      if (!t || !t.closest) return;
  
      var el = t.closest('a, button, [role=\"button\"], [role=\"tab\"], [role=\"link\"], summary');
      if (!el) return;
  
      var text = linkText(el);
      var TEXT = norm(text);
      var section = sectionOf(el);
      var nav = inNav(el);
  
      var url = null;
      if (el.tagName === 'A' && el.getAttribute('href')) {
        try { url = new URL(el.href, location.href); } catch (err) {}
      }
      var host = url ? url.hostname.replace(/^www\./, '') : '';
      var siteHost = location.hostname.replace(/^www\./, '');
      var dest = url ? (host === siteHost ? cleanPath(url.pathname) + (url.hash || '') : url.href) : '';
  
      // Email / phone
      if (url && (url.protocol === 'mailto:' || url.protocol === 'tel:')) {
        track('Contact Link Clicked', { type: url.protocol === 'mailto:' ? 'email' : 'phone', section: section }, true);
        return;
      }
  
      // Request a scoping session
      if (TEXT.indexOf('REQUEST A SCOPING SESSION') !== -1) {
        submitAttempt(el);
        return;
      }
  
      // Varya links
      if (url && host === VARYA_HOST) {
        var placement = nav ? 'nav'
          : TEXT.indexOf('TRY VARYA NOW') !== -1 ? 'hero_button'
          : (TEXT.indexOf('TRY VARYA') !== -1 || TEXT.indexOf('DISTILLED VIDEO MODEL') !== -1 || text === '|' || text === '→') ? 'banner'
          : (section || 'other');
        el.href = varyaUrl(el.href, placement);
        track('Try Varya Clicked', { placement: placement, link_text: text, section: section }, true);
        return;
      }
  
      // Social icons
      if (url) {
        for (var s in SOCIAL) {
          if (host === s || host.slice(-(s.length + 1)) === '.' + s) {
            track('Social Clicked', { network: SOCIAL[s], section: section }, true);
            return;
          }
        }
      }
  
      // Technical report card
      if (ancestorHasText(el, 'TECHNICAL REPORT', 6)) {
        track('Technical Report Clicked', { section: section, destination: dest }, true);
        return;
      }
  
      // Industry tabs (Proof section)
      for (var i = 0; i < INDUSTRIES.length; i++) {
        if (TEXT === INDUSTRIES[i].toUpperCase()) {
          track('Industry Tab Clicked', { industry: INDUSTRIES[i], section: section });
          return;

#avx-proof .bench {

}

  gap: clamp(16px, 2.4vw, 32px);
  align-items: center;
}

#avx-proof .who {

  color: var(--t2);
  line-height: 1.35;
}

#avx-proof .line {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: clamp(12px, 1.4vw, 20px);
  min-width: 0;
}

#avx-proof .tower {
  display: flex;
  gap: clamp(2px, .35vw, 5px);
  flex: none;
  width: calc((100% - clamp(130px, 16vw, 230px)) * var(--frac));
}
#avx-proof .tower.us { --frac: .5278; }
#avx-proof .tower.them { --frac: 1; }

#avx-proof .tower i {
  display: block;
  flex: 1 1 0;
  min-width: 2px;
  height: clamp(44px, 5vw, 68px);
  border-radius: 999px;
  transition: opacity .25s, transform .45s cubic-bezier(.3,1.5,.5,1);
  transition-delay: calc(.3s + var(--k) * 50ms);
}
#avx-proof .tower.us i {
  background: var(--b);
  box-shadow: 0 0 10px rgba(65,105,249,.25);
}
#avx-proof .tower.them i { background: var(--lofill); }

#avx-proof .big {
  font-size: clamp(36px, 4.6vw, 68px);
  font-weight: 600;
  letter-spacing: -.05em;
  line-height: 1;
  white-space: nowrap;
  font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums;
}
#avx-proof .row.us .big { color: var(--b); }
#avx-proof .row.them .big { color: #92929B; }

#avx-proof .acc {
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 10px;
  padding: 8px 16px 8px 8px;
  border-radius: 999px;
  border: 1px solid var(--trk);
  transition: opacity .6s 1.4s, transform .6s 1.4s var(--ease);
}
#avx-proof .acc svg {
  width: 44px;
  height: 44px;
  transform: rotate(-90deg);
  flex: none;
}
#avx-proof .acc circle { fill: none; stroke-width: 5; }
#avx-proof .acc .at { stroke: var(--trk); }
#avx-proof .acc .av {
  stroke-linecap: round;
  stroke-dasharray: 113.1;
  stroke-dashoffset: var(--o);
  transition: stroke-dashoffset 1.4s var(--ease) 1.5s;
}
#avx-proof .acc.us .av { stroke: var(--b); }
#avx-proof .acc.them .av { stroke: var(--lofill); }
#avx-proof .acc b {
  display: block;
  font-size: 22px;
  font-weight: 600;
  letter-spacing: -.03em;
  line-height: 1;
  font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums;
}
#avx-proof .acc small {

  color: var(--t3);

}
#avx-proof .acc.us {
  border-color: var(--b);
  box-shadow: 0 0 0 4px rgba(65,105,249,.12);
}
#avx-proof .acc.us b { color: var(--b); }
#avx-proof .acc.them b { color: var(--t2); }

#avx-proof .vs {

  font-weight: 600;
  color: var(--t3);

}

#avx-proof .sub {

  color: var(--t2);
  line-height: 1.5;
  max-width: 46ch;
  margin: clamp(40px, 4vw, 56px) auto 0;
  text-wrap: balance;
  transition: opacity .8s 1.6s, transform .8s 1.6s;
}
#avx-proof .mono {
  font: 13px/1.6 var(--m);
  color: var(--t3);
  margin-top: 14px;
  transition: opacity .8s 1.9s;
}
#avx-proof .mono b { font-weight: 500; color: var(--b); }

#avx-proof .bench.anim:not(.in) .tower i {
  opacity: 0;
  transform: translateX(-40px) scaleY(.4);
}
#avx-proof .bench.anim:not(.in) .acc {
  opacity: 0;
  transform: translateX(16px);
}
#avx-proof .bench.anim:not(.in) .acc .av {

}
#avx-proof .bench.anim:not(.in) .sub {
  opacity: 0;

}
#avx-proof .bench.anim:not(.in) .mono { opacity: 0; }

(function () {
  var root = document.getElementById(\"avx-proof\");
  if (!root) return;

  var reduceMotion = window.matchMedia &&
    window.matchMedia(\"(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)\").matches;

  /* BENCHMARK COUNT-UP */
  var bench = root.querySelector(\".bench\");

  function tween(el, dur, delay, render) {
    var t0 = null;

    setTimeout(function () {
      function step(t) {
        if (!t0) t0 = t;
        var k = Math.min((t - t0) / dur, 1);
        render(1 - Math.pow(1 - k, 3));

        if (k < 1) requestAnimationFrame(step);
      }
      requestAnimationFrame(step);
    }, delay);
  }

  function play() {
    bench.classList.add(\"in\");

    bench.querySelectorAll(\"[data-to]\").forEach(function (el) {
      var to = parseFloat(el.getAttribute(\"data-to\"));
      tween(
        el,
        +el.getAttribute(\"data-dur\") || 1600,
        +el.getAttribute(\"data-delay\") || 200,
        function (e) {
          el.textContent = \"$\" + (to * e).toFixed(2);
        }
      );
    });

    bench.querySelectorAll(\"[data-pc]\").forEach(function (el) {
      var to = parseInt(el.getAttribute(\"data-pc\"), 10);
      tween(el, 1400, 1500, function (e) {
        el.textContent = Math.round(to * e) + \"%\";
      });
    });
  }

  if (bench && !reduceMotion) {
    bench.classList.add(\"anim\");

    bench.querySelectorAll(\"[data-to]\").forEach(function (el) {
      el.textContent = \"$0.00\";
    });
    bench.querySelectorAll(\"[data-pc]\").forEach(function (el) {
      el.textContent = \"0%\";
    });

    if (!(\"IntersectionObserver\" in window)) {
      play();
    } else {
      var io = new IntersectionObserver(function (entries) {
        if (entries[0].isIntersecting) {
          play();
          io.disconnect();
        }
      }, { threshold: 0.3 });

      io.observe(bench.querySelector(\".rows\"));
    }
  }
})();
</script>

.avx-rail {
  --b: #4169F9;
  --fg: #F5F5F6;
  --t3: #85858F;
  --ln: rgba(255,255,255,.10);
  --ln2: rgba(255,255,255,.18);
  --s1: #0E0E11;
  --s2: #16161A;
  --f: \"Instrument Sans\", \"Helvetica Neue\",
       ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system,
       \"Segoe UI\", sans-serif;

  background: #000;
  color: var(--fg);
  font-family: var(--f);
  -webkit-font-smoothing: antialiased;
  line-height: 1.5;

  padding: clamp(32px,4vw,52px)
           clamp(20px,4.5vw,64px);

  overflow: hidden;
}

.avx-rail *,
.avx-rail *::before,
.avx-rail *::after {
  box-sizing: border-box;
}

.avx-rail p {
  margin: 0;
}

.avx-rail .in {
  max-width: 1320px;
  margin: 0 auto;
}

.avx-rail .q {
  font-size: 15px;
  font-weight: 500;
  color: var(--t3);
}

/* =========================================
   DESKTOP DECK
========================================= */

.avx-rail .deck {
  display: flex;
  gap: 12px;
  height: 400px;
  margin-top: 24px;
}

/* =========================================
   CARD
========================================= */

.avx-rail .c {
  appearance: none;
  font: inherit;
  text-align: left;
  cursor: pointer;

  position: relative;
  flex: 1 1 0;
  min-width: 0;

  border-radius: 28px;
  background: var(--s1);
  border: 1px solid var(--ln);
  color: var(--fg);

  padding: 24px;
  overflow: hidden;

  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: space-between;
  gap: 24px;

  -webkit-tap-highlight-color: transparent;
  touch-action: manipulation;

  transition:
    flex-grow .5s cubic-bezier(.2,.8,.2,1),
    background .3s ease,
    border-color .3s ease;
}

@media (hover:hover) {
  .avx-rail .c:hover {
    background: var(--s2);
  }
}

.avx-rail .c:focus-visible {
  outline: 2px solid var(--b);
  outline-offset: 3px;
}

.avx-rail .c.on {
  flex-grow: 4.2;
  background: var(--b);
  border-color: transparent;
  color: #fff;
  align-items: stretch;
  justify-content: flex-end;
  padding: 32px;
}

/* =========================================
   COLLAPSED CONTENT
========================================= */

.avx-rail .ic {
  width: 52px;
  height: 52px;
  border-radius: 50%;
  border: 1px solid var(--ln2);

  display: grid;
  place-items: center;
  flex: none;
}

.avx-rail .ic svg {
  width: 24px;
  height: 24px;
}

.avx-rail .lab {
  writing-mode: vertical-rl;
  transform: rotate(180deg);
  white-space: nowrap;

  font-size: 20px;
  font-weight: 600;
  letter-spacing: -.01em;
  line-height: 1.1;
}

.avx-rail .c.on .ic,
.avx-rail .c.on .lab {
  display: none;
}

/* =========================================
   ICONS
========================================= */

.avx-rail svg {
  fill: none;
  stroke: currentColor;
  stroke-width: 1.6;
  stroke-linecap: round;
  stroke-linejoin: round;
}

/* =========================================
   ACTIVE GLYPH
========================================= */

.avx-rail .glyph {
  display: none;
}

.avx-rail .c.on .glyph {
  display: block;
  position: absolute;

  top: -36px;
  right: -36px;
  width: 260px;
  height: 260px;

  color: rgba(255,255,255,.22);
  pointer-events: none;

  animation: avx-rail-glyph .5s ease both;
}

.avx-rail .glyph svg {
  width: 100%;
  height: 100%;
  stroke-width: .7;
}

/* =========================================
   ACTIVE CONTENT
========================================= */

.avx-rail .body {
  display: none;
}

.avx-rail .c.on .body {
  position: relative;
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  height: 100%;
  justify-content: space-between;

  animation: avx-rail-fade .35s ease both;
}

.avx-rail .kick {
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 10px;

  font-size: 13px;
  font-weight: 600;
  letter-spacing: .08em;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  color: rgba(255,255,255,.85);
}

.avx-rail .kick::before {
  content: \"\";
  width: 8px;
  height: 8px;
  border-radius: 50%;
  background: #fff;
  flex: none;
}

.avx-rail .txt {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: 16px;
  max-width: 42ch;
}

.avx-rail .ttl {
  font-size: clamp(26px,2.5vw,34px);
  font-weight: 600;
  letter-spacing: -.03em;
  line-height: 1.05;
  color: #fff;
}

.avx-rail .desc {
  font-size: clamp(17px,1.45vw,19px);
  line-height: 1.5;
  letter-spacing: -.01em;
  color: rgba(255,255,255,.92);
}

/* =========================================
   ANIMATIONS
========================================= */

@keyframes avx-rail-fade {
  from {
    opacity: 0;
    transform: translateY(6px);
  }
  to {
    opacity: 1;
    transform: translateY(0);
  }
}

@keyframes avx-rail-glyph {
  from {
    opacity: 0;
    transform: scale(.96);
  }
  to {
    opacity: 1;
    transform: scale(1);
  }
}

/* =========================================
   TABLET + MOBILE
========================================= */

@media (max-width:900px) {

  .avx-rail {
    padding: 26px 20px 28px;
  }

  .avx-rail .q {
    font-size: 14px;
  }

  .avx-rail .deck {
    flex-direction: column;
    height: auto;
    gap: 9px;
    margin-top: 16px;
  }

  .avx-rail .c {
    flex: none;
    width: 100%;
    min-height: 70px;

    padding: 11px 16px;
    border-radius: 18px;

    flex-direction: row;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: flex-start;
    gap: 14px;

    transition:
      background .2s ease,
      border-color .2s ease;
  }

  .avx-rail .ic {
    width: 44px;
    height: 44px;
  }

  .avx-rail .ic svg {
    width: 21px;
    height: 21px;
  }

  .avx-rail .lab {
    writing-mode: horizontal-tb;
    transform: none;
    white-space: normal;
    font-size: 17px;
    line-height: 1.2;
  }

  /* EXPANDED CARD */

  .avx-rail .c.on {
    flex-direction: column;
    align-items: stretch;
    justify-content: flex-start;

    padding: 20px;
    min-height: 0;
    gap: 0;
    border-radius: 20px;
  }

  .avx-rail .c.on .body {
    height: auto;
    gap: 32px;
    animation: avx-rail-fade .22s ease both;
  }

  .avx-rail .c.on .glyph {
    width: 155px;
    height: 155px;
    top: -30px;
    right: -30px;
    animation: none;
  }

  .avx-rail .kick {
    font-size: 11px;
    letter-spacing: .07em;
    gap: 8px;
  }

  .avx-rail .kick::before {
    width: 6px;
    height: 6px;
  }

  .avx-rail .txt {
    gap: 10px;
    max-width: none;
  }

  .avx-rail .ttl {
    font-size: 27px;
    line-height: 1.1;
  }

  .avx-rail .desc {
    font-size: 16px;
    line-height: 1.45;
  }
}

/* =========================================
   SMALL MOBILE
========================================= */

@media (max-width:480px) {

  .avx-rail {
    padding: 20px 16px 22px;
  }

  .avx-rail .q {
    font-size: 13px;
    line-height: 1.4;
  }

  .avx-rail .deck {
    gap: 8px;

  }

  /* COLLAPSED CARD */

  .avx-rail .c {
    min-height: 64px;

    width: 19px;

    letter-spacing: -.005em;
  }

  .avx-rail .txt {
    gap: 9px;

}

/* =========================================

========================================= */

@media (max-width:360px) {

  .avx-rail {
    padding-left: 12px;

  }

/* =========================================

========================================= */

  function selectCard(index) {
    var next = current === index ? -1 : index;

    current = next;

    cards.forEach(function (card, i) {
      var active = i === current;

      card.classList.toggle(\"on\", active);
      card.setAttribute(\"aria-expanded\", String(active));
      card.setAttribute(
        \"aria-label\",
        ROLES[i].label + (active ? \", collapse\" : \", expand\")
      );

  ROLES.forEach(function (role, index) {

    button.setAttribute(\"aria-expanded\", String(index === 0));
    button.setAttribute(

      role.label + (index === 0 ? \", collapse\" : \", expand\")
    );

    button.innerHTML =

      } else if (event.key === \"End\") {

      } else {
        return;
      }

      event.preventDefault();
      cards[next].focus();

      if (current !== next) {
        selectCard(next);
      }

  if (!root) return;

    var io = new IntersectionObserver(function (entries) {

    \"avx-bring-workflow\"
  );

  if (!workflowLink) return;

  workflowLink.addEventListener(\"click\", function (e) {
    var destination = new URL(workflowLink.href);
    var current = new URL(window.location.href);

    var normalizePath = function(path) {
      return path.replace(/\/+$/, \"\") || \"/\";
    };

    var isSamePage =
      destination.origin === current.origin &&
      normalizePath(destination.pathname) ===
      normalizePath(current.pathname);

    if (!isSamePage) {
      return;
    }

      \"scope-a-workflow\"
    );

      return;

  var qs = root.querySelectorAll(\".q\");

      var wasOpen = q.classList.contains(\"open\");

          window.scrollBy({
            top: top - 16,
            behavior: reduceMotion ? \"auto\" : \"smooth\"
          });
        }
      }, reduceMotion ? 0 : 460);
    });
  });
})();

(function(){

  var root = document.getElementById(\"avx-why-1\");

    el.addEventListener(\"mousemove\",function(e){

      if(window.matchMedia(\"(hover:none)\").matches) return;

      var r = el.getBoundingClientRect();

      el.style.setProperty(
        \"--mx\",
        (e.clientX-r.left)+\"px\"
      );

      el.style.setProperty(
        \"--my\",
        (e.clientY-r.top)+\"px\"
      );

    });

  });

  /* SMOOTH SCROLL TO HERO */

  root.querySelectorAll('a[href*=\"#hero-section\"]').forEach(function(link){

    link.addEventListener(\"click\",function(e){

      var url = new URL(link.href,location.href);

      var samePage =
        url.origin === location.origin &&
        url.pathname.replace(/\/$/,\"\") ===
        location.pathname.replace(/\/$/,\"\");

      if(!samePage) return;

      var target = document.getElementById(\"hero-section\");

      if(!target) return;

      e.preventDefault();

      var reduceMotion = window.matchMedia(
        \"(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce)\"
      ).matches;

      target.scrollIntoView({
        behavior: reduceMotion ? \"auto\" : \"smooth\",
        block: \"start\"
      });

      history.replaceState(
        null,
        \"\",
        url.pathname + url.search + url.hash
      );

    });

  });

})();

<script>
(function(){

  const host = document.getElementById(\"avx-field\");
  if (!host) return;

  const cv = host.querySelector(\"canvas\");
  const ctx = cv.getContext(\"2d\");
  if (!ctx) return;

  const ghost = host.querySelector(\".btn.ghost\");

  const reduce = window.matchMedia(
    \"(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce)\"
  ).matches;

  const blue = \"#4169F9\";

  const mobileQuery = window.matchMedia(
    \"(max-width:700px)\"
  );

  let mobile = mobileQuery.matches;

  let R = mobile ? 145 : 180;
  let R2 = R * R;
  let L = mobile ? 112 : 120;
  let L2 = L * L;

  const NB = 8;
  const whiteB = [];
  const blueB = [];
  const whiteStyle = [];
  const blueAlpha = [];

  for (let k=0;k<NB;k++) {
    whiteB.push([]);
    blueB.push([]);

    const t = (k+.5)/NB;

    whiteStyle.push(
      \"rgba(255,255,255,\" +
      (0.09*t).toFixed(3) + \")\"
    );

    blueAlpha.push(t*.9);
  }

  let W=0, H=0;
  let P=[];
  let near=new Uint8Array(0);

  let mx=-9999, my=-9999;
  let raf=0;
  let visible=true;
  let pending=0;

  let touchActive=false;
  let touchTimer=null;
  let touchGlowX=-9999;
  let touchGlowY=-9999;

  let glassRect=null;

  function updateGlassRect(){
    if (!ghost) return;

    const hr=host.getBoundingClientRect();
    const r=ghost.getBoundingClientRect();

    glassRect={
      x:r.left-hr.left,
      y:r.top-hr.top,
      w:r.width,
      h:r.height
    };
  }

  function size(w,h){

    if(Math.abs(w-W)<1 && Math.abs(h-H)<1)
      return;

    const oldW=W, oldH=H;

    W=Math.max(1,w);
    H=Math.max(1,h);

    mobile=mobileQuery.matches;

    R=mobile?145:180;
    R2=R*R;

    L=mobile?112:120;
    L2=L*L;

    const dpr=Math.min(
      window.devicePixelRatio||1,2
    );

    cv.width=Math.round(W*dpr);
    cv.height=Math.round(H*dpr);

    ctx.setTransform(dpr,0,0,dpr,0,0);

    if(oldW && oldH){
      const sx=W/oldW;
      const sy=H/oldH;

      P.forEach(p=>{
        p.x*=sx;
        p.y*=sy;
      });
    }

    const density=mobile?4900:9000;

    const n=Math.round(
      Math.min(
        mobile?95:140,
        Math.max(
          mobile?42:25,
          W*H/density
        )
      )
    );

    while(P.length<n){
      P.push({
        x:Math.random()*W,
        y:Math.random()*H,
        vx:(Math.random()-.5)*.35,
        vy:(Math.random()-.5)*.35,
        r:Math.random()<.12?2.4:1.3
      });
    }

    P.length=n;
    near=new Uint8Array(n);

    updateGlassRect();
  }

  function pillPath(x,y,w,h,r){

    if(typeof ctx.roundRect===\"function\"){
      ctx.roundRect(x,y,w,h,r);
      return;
    }

    r=Math.min(r,w/2,h/2);

    ctx.moveTo(x+r,y);
    ctx.arcTo(x+w,y,x+w,y+h,r);
    ctx.arcTo(x+w,y+h,x,y+h,r);
    ctx.arcTo(x,y+h,x,y,r);
    ctx.arcTo(x,y,x+w,y,r);
    ctx.closePath();
  }

  function fadeBehindGlass(){

    if(!glassRect || !glassRect.w)
      return;

    const {x,y,w,h}=glassRect;
    const pad=5;

    ctx.save();

    ctx.globalCompositeOperation=
      \"destination-out\";

    ctx.beginPath();

    pillPath(
      x-pad,
      y-pad,
      w+pad*2,
      h+pad*2,
      h/2+pad
    );

    ctx.fillStyle=\"rgba(0,0,0,.88)\";
    ctx.fill();

    ctx.restore();
  }

  function strokeBucket(list){

    ctx.beginPath();

    for(let s=0;s<list.length;s+=4){
      ctx.moveTo(list[s],list[s+1]);
      ctx.lineTo(list[s+2],list[s+3]);
    }

    ctx.stroke();
  }

  function draw(){

    ctx.clearRect(0,0,W,H);

    const n=P.length;

    let i,j,p,q,dx,dy,d,b,arr;

    for(i=0;i<n;i++){

      p=P[i];

      if(!reduce){
        p.x+=p.vx;
        p.y+=p.vy;
      }

      if(p.x<0){
        p.x=0;
        p.vx=Math.abs(p.vx);
      }

      if(p.x>W){
        p.x=W;
        p.vx=-Math.abs(p.vx);
      }

      if(p.y<0){
        p.y=0;
        p.vy=Math.abs(p.vy);
      }

      if(p.y>H){
        p.y=H;
        p.vy=-Math.abs(p.vy);
      }

      dx=mx-p.x;
      dy=my-p.y;

      if(!reduce && dx*dx+dy*dy<R2){
        p.x+=dx*(mobile?.018:.012);
        p.y+=dy*(mobile?.018:.012);

        dx=mx-p.x;
        dy=my-p.y;
      }

      near[i]=
        (dx*dx+dy*dy<R2)?1:0;
    }

    for(b=0;b<NB;b++){
      whiteB[b].length=0;
      blueB[b].length=0;
    }

    for(i=0;i<n;i++){

      p=P[i];
      arr=near[i]?blueB:whiteB;

      for(j=i+1;j<n;j++){

        q=P[j];

        dx=p.x-q.x;
        dy=p.y-q.y;
        d=dx*dx+dy*dy;

        if(d<L2){

          b=((1-d/L2)*NB)|0;
          if(b>=NB)b=NB-1;

          arr[b].push(
            p.x,p.y,q.x,q.y
          );
        }
      }
    }

    ctx.lineWidth=1;

    for(b=0;b<NB;b++){

      if(!whiteB[b].length)continue;

      ctx.strokeStyle=whiteStyle[b];
      strokeBucket(whiteB[b]);
    }

    ctx.lineWidth=1.2;
    ctx.strokeStyle=blue;

    for(b=0;b<NB;b++){

      if(!blueB[b].length)continue;

      ctx.globalAlpha=blueAlpha[b];
      strokeBucket(blueB[b]);
    }

    ctx.globalAlpha=1;

    const TAU=Math.PI*2;

    ctx.fillStyle=\"rgba(255,255,255,.45)\";
    ctx.beginPath();

    for(i=0;i<n;i++){

      p=P[i];

      if(near[i]||p.r>2)continue;

      ctx.moveTo(p.x+p.r,p.y);
      ctx.arc(p.x,p.y,p.r,0,TAU);
    }

    ctx.fill();

    ctx.fillStyle=blue;
    ctx.beginPath();

    for(i=0;i<n;i++){

      p=P[i];

      if(near[i]||p.r<=2)continue;

      ctx.moveTo(p.x+p.r,p.y);
      ctx.arc(p.x,p.y,p.r,0,TAU);
    }

    ctx.fill();

    ctx.fillStyle=\"#fff\";
    ctx.beginPath();

    for(i=0;i<n;i++){

      if(!near[i])continue;

      p=P[i];

      const r=p.r+.8;

      ctx.moveTo(p.x+r,p.y);
      ctx.arc(p.x,p.y,r,0,TAU);
    }

    ctx.fill();

    fadeBehindGlass();

    if(
      mobile &&
      touchActive &&
      touchGlowX>=0
    ){

      const g=ctx.createRadialGradient(
        touchGlowX,touchGlowY,0,
        touchGlowX,touchGlowY,110
      );

      g.addColorStop(
        0,\"rgba(65,105,249,.10)\"
      );

      g.addColorStop(
        1,\"rgba(65,105,249,0)\"
      );

      ctx.fillStyle=g;

      ctx.fillRect(
        touchGlowX-110,
        touchGlowY-110,
        220,220
      );
    }
  }

  function loop(){

    draw();

    raf=(visible&&!document.hidden)
      ?requestAnimationFrame(loop)
      :0;
  }

  function start(){

    if(
      reduce ||
      raf ||
      !visible ||
      document.hidden
    )return;

    raf=requestAnimationFrame(loop);
  }

  function stop(){
    cancelAnimationFrame(raf);
    raf=0;
  }

  function redraw(){

    if(!reduce||pending)return;

    pending=requestAnimationFrame(()=>{
      pending=0;
      draw();
    });
  }

  function setPointer(x,y){

    const r=host.getBoundingClientRect();

    mx=x-r.left;
    my=y-r.top;

    touchGlowX=mx;
    touchGlowY=my;

    redraw();
  }

  function clearPointer(){

    mx=-9999;
    my=-9999;

    touchGlowX=-9999;
    touchGlowY=-9999;

    touchActive=false;

    redraw();
  }

  function syncLayout(){

    const r=host.getBoundingClientRect();

    size(r.width,r.height);
    updateGlassRect();

    if(reduce)redraw();
  }

  function init(){

    syncLayout();
    draw();
    start();

    host.addEventListener(
      \"mousemove\",
      e=>{
        if(
          e.sourceCapabilities &&
          e.sourceCapabilities.firesTouchEvents
        )return;

        setPointer(e.clientX,e.clientY);
      },
      {passive:true}
    );

    host.addEventListener(
      \"mouseleave\",
      ()=>{
        if(!touchActive)clearPointer();
      },
      {passive:true}
    );

    function onTouch(e){

      if(!e.touches.length)return;

      clearTimeout(touchTimer);
      touchActive=true;

      const t=e.touches[0];

      setPointer(t.clientX,t.clientY);
    }

    host.addEventListener(
      \"touchstart\",onTouch,{passive:true}
    );

    host.addEventListener(
      \"touchmove\",onTouch,{passive:true}
    );

    function endTouch(){

      clearTimeout(touchTimer);

      touchTimer=setTimeout(
        clearPointer,700
      );
    }

    host.addEventListener(
      \"touchend\",endTouch,{passive:true}
    );

    host.addEventListener(
      \"touchcancel\",endTouch,{passive:true}
    );

    if(\"ResizeObserver\" in window){

      const observer=new ResizeObserver(
        syncLayout
      );

      observer.observe(host);

      if(ghost)observer.observe(ghost);

    }else{

      window.addEventListener(
        \"resize\",syncLayout
      );

      window.addEventListener(
        \"orientationchange\",
        ()=>setTimeout(syncLayout,250)
      );
    }

    if(document.fonts&&document.fonts.ready){
      document.fonts.ready.then(syncLayout);
    }

    if(\"IntersectionObserver\" in window){

      new IntersectionObserver(entries=>{

        visible=entries[0].isIntersecting;

        visible?start():stop();

      }).observe(host);
    }

    document.addEventListener(
      \"visibilitychange\",
      ()=>{
        document.hidden?stop():start();
      }
    );
  }

  requestAnimationFrame(()=>{
    setTimeout(init,0);
  });

})();
</script>

<script>
(function(){

  var root=document.getElementById(\"avx-sc-2\");

  if(!root)return;

  /* SCROLL REVEAL */

  function on(){
    root.classList.add(\"on\");
  }

  if(
    !(\"IntersectionObserver\" in window) ||
    (
      window.matchMedia &&
      window.matchMedia(
        \"(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)\"
      ).matches
    )
  ){
    on();
  }else{

    var io=new IntersectionObserver(function(entries){

      if(entries[0].isIntersecting){
        on();
        io.disconnect();
      }

    },{
      threshold:0.05
    });

    io.observe(root);
  }

  /* FORM ELEMENTS */

  var form=root.querySelector(\".frm\");
  var done=root.querySelector(\".done\");
  var error=root.querySelector(\".form-error\");
  var button=form.querySelector(\".btn\");
  var buttonLabel=form.querySelector(\".btn-label\");

  var endpoint=\"https://api.web3forms.com/submit\";

  var originalButtonText=\"Request a scoping session\";

  /* VALIDATION */

  function validate(){

    var valid=true;
    var firstInvalid=null;

    form.querySelectorAll(\"[required]\").forEach(function(input){

      var invalid=!input.validity.valid;
      var field=input.closest(\".fd\");

      if(field){
        field.classList.toggle(\"err\",invalid);
      }

      input.setAttribute(
        \"aria-invalid\",
        invalid?\"true\":\"false\"
      );

      if(invalid){
        valid=false;

        if(!firstInvalid){
          firstInvalid=input;
        }
      }

    });

    if(firstInvalid){
      firstInvalid.focus();
      firstInvalid.reportValidity();
    }

    return valid;
  }

  /* CLEAR VALIDATION ERRORS */

  form.querySelectorAll(
    \"input:not([type=hidden]),textarea,select\"
  ).forEach(function(input){

    function clearError(){

      var field=input.closest(\".fd\");

      if(field){
        field.classList.remove(\"err\");
      }

      input.removeAttribute(\"aria-invalid\");
      error.hidden=true;
    }

    input.addEventListener(\"input\",clearError);
    input.addEventListener(\"change\",clearError);

  });

  /* WEB3FORMS SUBMISSION */

  form.addEventListener(\"submit\",async function(e){

    e.preventDefault();

    if(button.disabled)return;

    if(!validate())return;

    button.disabled=true;
    buttonLabel.textContent=\"Sending request...\";
    error.hidden=true;

    try{

      var formData=new FormData(form);

      var response=await fetch(endpoint,{
        method:\"POST\",
        body:formData,
        headers:{
          \"Accept\":\"application/json\"
        }
      });

      var result=await response.json();

      if(
        !response.ok ||
        !result ||
        result.success!==true
      ){
        throw new Error(
          result && result.message
            ? result.message
            : \"Submission failed\"
        );
      }

      /* SUCCESS */

      form.hidden=true;
      done.hidden=false;

    }catch(err){

      console.error(
        \"Web3Forms submission failed:\",
        err
      );

      error.textContent=
        \"We couldn't submit your request. Please try again.\";

      error.hidden=false;
      button.disabled=false;
      buttonLabel.textContent=originalButtonText;

    }

  });

})();
</script>

(function(){

  var reduce = window.matchMedia(\"(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)\").matches;

  /* CARD CURSOR GLOW (pointer devices only) */
  if (canHover) {

  var scrollLink = root.querySelector(\"[data-scroll]\");

    scrollLink.addEventListener(\"click\", function(e){
      var id = scrollLink.getAttribute(\"data-scroll\");
      var win = window;
      var target = document.getElementById(id);

      // Embedded in a same-origin iframe? Look in the parent page.
      if (!target && window.parent !== window) {
        try {

          if (target) win = window.parent;

  var track = root.querySelector(\".track\");

  buttons.forEach(function(button){

      if(!track) return;

      var card = track.querySelector(\".card\");
      var gap = parseFloat(getComputedStyle(track).columnGap) || 12;
      var distance = card ? card.getBoundingClientRect().width + gap : 340;

      track.scrollBy({
        left: Number(button.dataset.nav) * distance,
        behavior: reduce ? \"auto\" : \"smooth\"
      });
    });
  });

  /* Disable prev/next at the ends of the carousel */
  function syncNav(){
    if(!track) return;

<meta charset=\"utf-8\">
<meta name=\"viewport\" content=\"width=device-width, initial-scale=1, viewport-fit=cover\">
<title>Avataar — The Platform</title>

<link rel=\"preconnect\" href=\"https://fonts.googleapis.com\">
<link rel=\"preconnect\" href=\"https://fonts.gstatic.com\" crossorigin=\"\">
<link rel=\"stylesheet\" href=\"https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=JetBrains+Mono:wght@400;500&#x26;display=swap\">

<style>
html,body{
  margin:0;
  padding:0;
  background:#fff;
}

#avx-plat-k{
  --b:#4169F9;
  --bg:#fff;
  --fg:#231F20;
  --t2:#52525B;
  --t3:#7D736E;
  --ln:rgba(35,31,32,.1);
  --ln2:rgba(35,31,32,.18);
  --s1:#F4F4F6;
  --s2:#ECECF0;
  --bt:#2C52E3;
  --ok:#3DD68C;
  --f:\"Helvetica Neue\",Helvetica,Arial,sans-serif;
  --m:\"JetBrains Mono\",ui-monospace,Menlo,monospace;

  position:relative;
  background:
    radial-gradient(
      ellipse 38% 20% at 82% 0%,
      rgba(65,105,249,.035),
      transparent 72%
    ),#fff;
  color:var(--fg);
  font-family:var(--f);
  -webkit-font-smoothing:antialiased;
  -webkit-text-size-adjust:100%;
  padding:clamp(80px,9vw,140px)
          clamp(20px,4vw,56px);
  min-height:1300px;
  overflow:hidden;
  overflow-anchor:none;
  line-height:1.5;
}

#avx-plat-k *{box-sizing:border-box}
#avx-plat-k h2,
#avx-plat-k h3,
#avx-plat-k p{margin:0}
#avx-plat-k a{color:inherit}
#avx-plat-k a:hover{color:inherit}

#avx-plat-k .in{
  position:relative;
  max-width:1320px;
  margin:0 auto;
}

/* HEADER — NO BLUE DOT */

#avx-plat-k .kick{
  display:inline-flex;
  align-items:center;
  gap:0;
  font:12px var(--m);
  letter-spacing:.14em;
  text-transform:uppercase;
  color:var(--t3);
}

#avx-plat-k .kick::before{
  content:none;
  display:none;
}

#avx-plat-k .h2{
  font-size:clamp(44px,5.6vw,84px);
  line-height:.98;
  letter-spacing:-.05em;
  font-weight:500;
  margin-top:16px!important;
  max-width:15ch;
}

#avx-plat-k .lead{
  font-size:clamp(18px,1.5vw,21px);
  line-height:1.5;
  color:var(--t2);
  max-width:56ch;
  margin-top:24px!important;
}

/* ICONS */

#avx-plat-k .ic{
  fill:none;
  stroke:currentColor;
  stroke-width:1.7;
  stroke-linecap:round;
  stroke-linejoin:round;
}

#avx-plat-k .chk{
  flex:none;
  width:18px;
  height:18px;
  margin-top:3px;
  stroke:var(--b);
  fill:none;
  stroke-width:2;
}

/* MAIN GRID */

#avx-plat-k .wrapk{
  display:grid;
  grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr) minmax(0,1.05fr);
  gap:clamp(32px,5vw,72px);
  margin-top:clamp(56px,6vw,88px);
  align-items:start;
}

/* LEFT LIST */

#avx-plat-k .list{
  position:relative;
  display:grid;
  border-top:1px solid var(--ln);
}

#avx-plat-k .pill{
  position:absolute;
  left:0;
  right:0;
  top:0;
  height:92px;
  border-radius:18px;
  background:#fff;
  box-shadow:
    0 1px 0 rgba(0,0,0,.04),
    0 18px 40px -18px rgba(35,31,32,.22),
    0 0 0 1px rgba(35,31,32,.07);
  transform:translateY(var(--py,0px));
  transition:transform .55s cubic-bezier(.2,.8,.2,1),height .3s;
  pointer-events:none;
}

#avx-plat-k .pill::before{
  content:\"\";
  position:absolute;
  left:0;
  top:22px;
  bottom:22px;
  width:3px;
  border-radius:0 3px 3px 0;
  background:var(--b);
}

/* ROW */

#avx-plat-k .row{
  all:unset;
  box-sizing:border-box;
  cursor:pointer;
  position:relative;
  height:92px;
  display:grid;
  grid-template-columns:76px minmax(0,1fr) auto;
  gap:16px;
  align-items:center;
  padding:0 22px;
  border-bottom:1px solid var(--ln);
  transition:border-color .3s;
  -webkit-tap-highlight-color:transparent;
  touch-action:manipulation;
}

#avx-plat-k .row:focus-visible{
  outline:2px solid var(--b);
  outline-offset:-2px;
  border-radius:18px;
}

#avx-plat-k .row .n{
  font-size:30px;
  font-weight:500;
  letter-spacing:.04em;
  font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums;
  color:transparent;
  -webkit-text-stroke:1px rgba(35,31,32,.28);
  transition:all .4s;
}

#avx-plat-k .row.on .n{
  color:var(--b);
  -webkit-text-stroke-color:var(--b);
}

#avx-plat-k .row b{
  display:block;
  font-size:17px;
  font-weight:500;
  letter-spacing:-.015em;
  transition:transform .4s cubic-bezier(.2,.8,.2,1);
}

#avx-plat-k .row small{
  display:block;
  font-size:13.5px;
  color:var(--t3);
  margin-top:3px;
  transition:transform .4s cubic-bezier(.2,.8,.2,1);
}

@media(hover:hover) and (pointer:fine){
  #avx-plat-k .row:hover .n{
    -webkit-text-stroke-color:rgba(35,31,32,.6);
  }
  #avx-plat-k .row.on:hover .n{
    -webkit-text-stroke-color:var(--b);
  }
  #avx-plat-k .row:hover b,
  #avx-plat-k .row:hover small{
    transform:translateX(4px);
  }
}

#avx-plat-k .row .tg{
  font:11px var(--m);
  color:var(--t3);
  white-space:nowrap;
  padding:5px 9px;
  border-radius:999px;
  border:1px solid transparent;
  transition:all .3s;
}

#avx-plat-k .row.on .tg{
  color:var(--bt);
  border-color:rgba(65,105,249,.3);
  background:rgba(65,105,249,.06);
}

#avx-plat-k .row .cv{
  display:none;
  width:18px;
  height:18px;
  color:var(--t3);
  transition:transform .35s cubic-bezier(.2,.8,.2,1),color .3s;
}

/* RIGHT PANEL */

#avx-plat-k .panel{
  position:sticky;
  top:40px;
  border-radius:28px;
  background:#0B0B0D;
  color:#F5F5F6;
  padding:
    clamp(30px,3.4vw,44px)
    clamp(30px,3.4vw,44px)
    64px;
  min-height:552px;
  overflow:hidden;
  box-shadow:
    0 34px 70px -38px rgba(65,105,249,.3),
    0 0 0 1px rgba(0,0,0,.6);
}

#avx-plat-k .panel[hidden]{display:none!important}

#avx-plat-k .panel::before{
  content:\"\";
  position:absolute;
  right:-24%;
  top:-36%;
  width:72%;
  height:72%;
  background:radial-gradient(
    circle,
    rgba(65,105,249,.28),
    transparent 64%
  );
  pointer-events:none;
}

#avx-plat-k .panel::after{
  content:\"\";
  position:absolute;
  inset:0;
  background:radial-gradient(
    360px circle at var(--mx,70%) var(--my,10%),
    rgba(255,255,255,.045),
    transparent 48%
  );
  pointer-events:none;
}

/* LARGE NUMBER */

#avx-plat-k .wm{
  position:absolute;
  right:24px;
  bottom:-34px;
  font-size:220px;
  font-weight:500;
  letter-spacing:0;
  line-height:1;
  color:transparent;
  -webkit-text-stroke:1px rgba(255,255,255,.08);
  pointer-events:none;
  animation:wm .7s cubic-bezier(.2,.8,.2,1) both;
}

@keyframes wm{
  from{opacity:0;transform:translateY(30px)}
  to{opacity:1;transform:none}
}

/* PANEL CONTENT */

#avx-plat-k .pf{
  position:relative;
  z-index:1;
  animation:fade .45s both;
}

@keyframes fade{
  from{opacity:0;transform:translateY(10px)}
  to{opacity:1;transform:none}
}

#avx-plat-k .ph{
  display:flex;
  align-items:center;
  gap:14px;
}

#avx-plat-k .badge{
  flex:none;
  width:48px;
  height:48px;
  border-radius:14px;
  background:var(--b);
  display:grid;
  place-items:center;
  color:#fff;
  box-shadow:0 10px 28px -10px rgba(65,105,249,.65);
}

#avx-plat-k .badge svg{
  width:24px;
  height:24px;
}

#avx-plat-k .pk{
  font:12px var(--m);
  letter-spacing:.14em;
  text-transform:uppercase;
  color:#8AA3FF;
}

#avx-plat-k .pt{
  display:block;
  font:12px var(--m);
  color:#85858F;
  margin-top:4px;
}

#avx-plat-k .pf h3{
  font-size:clamp(28px,2.6vw,38px);
  font-weight:500;
  letter-spacing:-.04em;
  line-height:1.05;
  margin-top:26px;
}

#avx-plat-k .pf .p{
  font-size:16px;
  color:#B4B4BC;
  margin-top:16px;
  line-height:1.6;
  max-width:52ch;
}

/* BULLETS */

#avx-plat-k .pf ul{
  list-style:none;
  margin:24px 0 0;
  padding:0;
  display:grid;
  gap:10px;
  font-size:15px;
  color:#E4E4E7;
}

#avx-plat-k .pf li{
  display:flex;
  gap:12px;
  align-items:flex-start;
  padding:12px 14px;
  border-radius:12px;
  background:rgba(255,255,255,.04);

#avx-plat-k .pf li:nth-child(2){animation-delay:.06s}
#avx-plat-k .pf li:nth-child(3){animation-delay:.12s}

#avx-plat-k .pf .chk{stroke:#8AA3FF}

/* YOU KEEP */

#avx-plat-k .km{
  display:inline-flex;
  align-items:center;
  gap:10px;
  margin-top:26px;
  padding:10px 14px;
  border-radius:999px;
  font:13px var(--m);
  color:#3DD68C;
  background:rgba(61,214,140,.08);
  border:1px solid rgba(61,214,140,.25);
  text-transform:lowercase;
}

#avx-plat-k .km svg{
  width:15px;
  height:15px;
  fill:none;
  stroke:currentColor;
  stroke-width:1.8;
  flex:none;
}

/* PANEL INDICATORS */

#avx-plat-k .ticks{
  position:absolute;
  left:clamp(30px,3.4vw,44px);
  right:clamp(30px,3.4vw,44px);
  bottom:26px;
  display:flex;
  gap:6px;
  z-index:1;
}

#avx-plat-k .ticks i{
  flex:1;
  height:3px;
  border-radius:3px;
  background:rgba(255,255,255,.1);
  transition:background .4s;
}

#avx-plat-k .ticks i.on{background:var(--b)}

#avx-plat-k .lp{
  position:relative;
  display:grid;
  grid-template-columns:repeat(5,minmax(0,1fr));
  gap:12px;
  margin-top:clamp(72px,8vw,112px);

}

  letter-spacing:-.02em;

#avx-plat-k .lnk:hover{

#avx-plat-k .lnk:focus-visible{

#avx-plat-k .or{color:var(--t3)}

<script>
(function(){

  var root=document.getElementById(\"avx-sc-2\");

  if(!root)return;

  /* REVEAL */

  function on(){
    root.classList.add(\"on\");
  }

  if(
    !(\"IntersectionObserver\" in window) ||
    (
      window.matchMedia &&
      window.matchMedia(
        \"(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)\"
      ).matches
    )
  ){
    on();
  }else{

    var io=new IntersectionObserver(function(entries){

      if(entries[0].isIntersecting){
        on();
        io.disconnect();
      }

    },{
      threshold:0.05
    });

    io.observe(root);
  }

  /* FORM ELEMENTS */

  var form=root.querySelector(\".frm\");
  var done=root.querySelector(\".done\");
  var error=root.querySelector(\".form-error\");
  var button=form.querySelector(\".btn\");
  var buttonLabel=form.querySelector(\".btn-label\");

  var endpoint=\"https://api.staticforms.dev/submit\";

  var nameInput=form.querySelector(\"#f2-name\");
  var emailInput=form.querySelector(\"#f2-email\");
  var companyInput=form.querySelector(\"#f2-company\");
  var roleInput=form.querySelector(\"#f2-role\");
  var workflowInput=form.querySelector(\"#f2-wf\");
  var whenInput=form.querySelector(\"#f2-when\");
  var messageInput=form.querySelector(\"#sc-message\");

  var originalButtonText=\"Request a scoping session\";

  /* VALIDATION */

  function validate(){

    var valid=true;
    var firstInvalid=null;

    form.querySelectorAll(\"[required]\").forEach(function(input){

      var value=input.value.trim();
      var invalid=!value;

      if(
        input.type===\"email\" &&
        value &&
        !/^[^\s@]+@[^\s@]+\.[^\s@]+$/.test(value)
      ){
        invalid=true;
      }

      var field=input.closest(\".fd\");

      if(field){
        field.classList.toggle(\"err\",invalid);
      }

      input.setAttribute(
        \"aria-invalid\",
        invalid?\"true\":\"false\"
      );

      if(invalid){
        valid=false;
        if(!firstInvalid)firstInvalid=input;
      }

    });

    if(firstInvalid){
      firstInvalid.focus();
    }

    return valid;
  }

  /* CLEAR VALIDATION ERRORS */

  form.querySelectorAll(
    \"input:not([type=hidden]),textarea,select\"
  ).forEach(function(input){

    function clearError(){

      var field=input.closest(\".fd\");

      if(field){
        field.classList.remove(\"err\");
      }

      input.removeAttribute(\"aria-invalid\");
      error.hidden=true;
    }

    input.addEventListener(\"input\",clearError);
    input.addEventListener(\"change\",clearError);

  });

  /* SUBMISSION */

  form.addEventListener(\"submit\",async function(e){

    e.preventDefault();

    if(button.disabled)return;

    if(!validate())return;

    /* Build complete message for email */

    messageInput.value=[
      \"NEW AVATAAR SCOPING SESSION REQUEST\",
      \"\",
      \"Name: \"+nameInput.value.trim(),
      \"Work email: \"+emailInput.value.trim(),
      \"Company: \"+companyInput.value.trim(),
      \"Role: \"+roleInput.value,
      \"\",
      \"THE WORKFLOW:\",
      workflowInput.value.trim() || \"Not provided\",
      \"\",
      \"WHEN:\",
      whenInput.value,
      \"\",
      \"Source: Avataar Website - Scoping Session\"
    ].join(\"\n\");

    /* Spam protection */

    var honey=form.querySelector(
      'input[name=\"honeypot\"]'
    );

    if(honey && honey.value.trim()){
      return;
    }

    /* Loading state */

    button.disabled=true;
    buttonLabel.textContent=\"Sending request...\";
    error.hidden=true;

    try{

      var formData=new FormData(form);

      var response=await fetch(endpoint,{
        method:\"POST\",
        body:formData,
        headers:{
          \"Accept\":\"application/json\"
        }
      });

      var result=null;

      try{
        result=await response.json();
      }catch(parseError){
        if(!response.ok){
          throw new Error(\"Submission failed\");
        }
      }

      if(!response.ok){
        throw new Error(
          result && result.message
            ? result.message
            : \"Submission failed\"
        );
      }

      if(
        result &&
        (
          result.success===false ||
          result.success===\"false\"
        )
      ){
        throw new Error(
          result.message || \"Submission failed\"
        );
      }

      /* Success */

      form.hidden=true;
      done.hidden=false;

    }catch(err){

      console.error(
        \"StaticForms submission failed:\",
        err
      );

      error.hidden=false;
      button.disabled=false;
      buttonLabel.textContent=originalButtonText;

    }

  });

})();
</script>

(function () {
  var root = document.getElementById(\"avx-proof\");
  if (!root) return;

  var reduceMotion = window.matchMedia &&
    window.matchMedia(\"(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)\").matches;

  /* BENCHMARK COUNT-UP */
  var bench = root.querySelector(\".bench\");

  function tween(el, dur, delay, render) {
    var t0 = null;

    setTimeout(function () {
      function step(t) {
        if (!t0) t0 = t;
        var k = Math.min((t - t0) / dur, 1);
        render(1 - Math.pow(1 - k, 3));

        if (k < 1) requestAnimationFrame(step);
      }
      requestAnimationFrame(step);
    }, delay);
  }

  function play() {
    bench.classList.add(\"in\");

    bench.querySelectorAll(\"[data-to]\").forEach(function (el) {
      var to = parseFloat(el.getAttribute(\"data-to\"));
      tween(
        el,
        +el.getAttribute(\"data-dur\") || 1600,
        +el.getAttribute(\"data-delay\") || 200,
        function (e) {
          el.textContent = \"$\" + (to * e).toFixed(2);
        }
      );
    });

    bench.querySelectorAll(\"[data-pc]\").forEach(function (el) {
      var to = parseInt(el.getAttribute(\"data-pc\"), 10);
      tween(el, 1400, 1500, function (e) {
        el.textContent = Math.round(to * e) + \"%\";
      });
    });
  }

  if (bench && !reduceMotion) {
    bench.classList.add(\"anim\");

    bench.querySelectorAll(\"[data-to]\").forEach(function (el) {
      el.textContent = \"$0.00\";
    });
    bench.querySelectorAll(\"[data-pc]\").forEach(function (el) {
      el.textContent = \"0%\";
    });

    if (!(\"IntersectionObserver\" in window)) {
      play();
    } else {
      var io = new IntersectionObserver(function (entries) {
        if (entries[0].isIntersecting) {
          play();
          io.disconnect();
        }
      }, { threshold: 0.3 });

      io.observe(bench.querySelector(\".rows\"));
    }
  }

  /* SMOOTH SCROLL TO SCOPE A WORKFLOW */
  var link = root.querySelector('a[href*=\"#scope-a-workflow\"]');

  if (link) {
    link.addEventListener(\"click\", function (e) {
      var url = \"https://www.avataar.ai/#scope-a-workflow\";

      try {
        var hostWindow = window.top;
        var hostDocument = hostWindow.document;
        var target = hostDocument.getElementById(\"scope-a-workflow\");

        var onHomepage =
          hostWindow.location.origin === \"https://www.avataar.ai\" &&
          (hostWindow.location.pathname.replace(/\/+$/, \"\") || \"/\") === \"/\";

        if (target && onHomepage) {
          e.preventDefault();

          target.scrollIntoView({
            behavior: reduceMotion ? \"auto\" : \"smooth\",
            block: \"start\"
          });

          if (hostWindow.location.hash !== \"#scope-a-workflow\") {
            hostWindow.history.pushState(null, \"\", url);
          }
        }
      } catch (err) {
        /* Fallback to full-page anchor navigation */
      }
    });
  }
})();

  <script>
  (function () {
    if (window.__avataarTracking) return;
    window.__avataarTracking = true;
  
    /* ===================== CONFIG ===================== */
    var VARYA_HOST = 'varya.avataar.ai';
    var PAGE_NAMES = {
      '/': 'Home',
      '/platform-and-technology': 'Platform & Technology',
      '/use-cases': 'Use Cases',
      '/about': 'About',
      '/contact': 'Contact'
    };
    var NAV_ITEMS = [
      'QUESTIONS', 'TRY IT LIVE', 'PLATFORM', 'HOW WE WORK', 'PROOF', 'WHY AVATAAR',
      'HOME', 'PLATFORM & TECHNOLOGY', 'USE CASES', 'ABOUT', 'CONTACT'
    ];
    var CTA_ITEMS = [
      'SCOPE A WORKFLOW', 'TRY IT LIVE', 'PUT IT ON THE SCOPING AGENDA', 'BRING ONE WORKFLOW',
      'RUN ONE YOURSELF', 'SCOPE YOURS', 'ASK WHAT THE NUMBER WOULD BE',
      'EVERY SCOPING SESSION INCLUDES A CONTROL-PLANE WALKTHROUGH',
      'DISCOVER', 'LEARN MORE', 'BOOK MEETING'
    ];
    var INDUSTRIES = ['Financial services', 'Healthcare', 'Real estate', 'Retail & consumer goods'];
    var SOCIAL = {
      'linkedin.com': 'LinkedIn', 'x.com': 'X', 'twitter.com': 'X',
      'instagram.com': 'Instagram', 'facebook.com': 'Facebook'
    };
    var UTM_KEYS = ['utm_source', 'utm_medium', 'utm_campaign', 'utm_content', 'utm_term'];
    var UTM_STORE = 'avataar-utm';
  
    /* ===================== HELPERS ===================== */
    function cleanPath(p) { return (p || '/').replace(/\/+$/, '') || '/'; }
    function pageNameFor(p) { p = cleanPath(p); return PAGE_NAMES[p] || p; }
  
    function track(name, props, beacon) {
      try {
        if (!window.mixpanel) return;
        props = props || {};
        if (!props.page) props.page = cleanPath(location.pathname);
        if (!props.page_name) props.page_name = pageNameFor(props.page);
        if (beacon) mixpanel.track(name, props, { transport: 'sendBeacon' });
        else mixpanel.track(name, props);
      } catch (e) {}
    }
  
    function linkText(el) {
      return String(el.innerText || el.textContent || el.getAttribute('aria-label') || el.title || '')
        .replace(/\s+/g, ' ').trim().slice(0, 120);
    }
    function norm(text) {
      return text.toUpperCase().replace(/[→↗➔➜›»]/g, '').replace(/\s+/g, ' ').trim();
    }
    function matchCta(TEXT) {
      for (var i = 0; i < CTA_ITEMS.length; i++) {
        if (TEXT === CTA_ITEMS[i] || TEXT.indexOf(CTA_ITEMS[i]) === 0) return true;
      }
      return false;
    }
  
    function sectionOf(el) {
      var n = el;
      while (n && n.nodeType === 1) {
        if (n.id && /^(SECTION|HEADER|FOOTER|NAV|MAIN|DIV)$/.test(n.tagName) && n.id !== 'avx-field') return n.id;
        n = n.parentElement;
      }
      var w = el.closest('header, nav, footer');
      return w ? w.tagName.toLowerCase() : '';
    }
  
    function inNav(el) {
      return !!el.closest('header, nav, [class*=\"nav\"], [id*=\"nav\"], [class*=\"header\"], [id*=\"header\"]');
    }
  
    function ancestorHasText(el, needle, maxDepth) {
      var n = el, d = 0;
      while (n && n.nodeType === 1 && d <= maxDepth) {
        var txt = String(n.innerText || n.textContent || '').toUpperCase();
        if (txt.length < 800 && txt.indexOf(needle) !== -1) return true;
        n = n.parentElement; d++;
      }
      return false;
    }
  
    // Finds which industry card an element belongs to
    function industryOf(el) {
      var n = el, d = 0;
      while (n && n.nodeType === 1 && d < 10) {
        var txt = String(n.innerText || n.textContent || '').toUpperCase();
        var found = [];
        for (var i = 0; i < INDUSTRIES.length; i++) {
          if (txt.indexOf(INDUSTRIES[i].toUpperCase()) !== -1) found.push(INDUSTRIES[i]);
        }
        if (found.length === 1) return found[0];
        if (found.length > 1) return '';
        n = n.parentElement; d++;
      }
      return '';
    }
  
    // Keep the landing UTMs for the whole visit
    (function saveUtm() {
      try {
        var here = new URLSearchParams(location.search), found = {}, any = false;
        UTM_KEYS.forEach(function (k) { if (here.get(k)) { found[k] = here.get(k); any = true; } });
        if (any) sessionStorage.setItem(UTM_STORE, JSON.stringify(found));
      } catch (e) {}
    })();
    function getUtm() {
      try { return JSON.parse(sessionStorage.getItem(UTM_STORE)) || {}; } catch (e) { return {}; }
    }
  
    function varyaUrl(href, medium) {
      var u = new URL(href, location.href);
      var utm = getUtm();
      u.searchParams.set('utm_source', 'avataar.ai');
      u.searchParams.set('utm_medium', medium);
      u.searchParams.set('utm_campaign', 'avataar_site');
      UTM_KEYS.forEach(function (k) { if (utm[k]) u.searchParams.set('ref_' + k, utm[k]); });
      u.searchParams.set('ref_page', cleanPath(location.pathname));
      try { var id = mixpanel.get_distinct_id(); if (id) u.searchParams.set('mp_ref_id', id); } catch (e) {}
